items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: And what I couldn't make on trombone, he'd make it himself and show me how to make it, you see.

ctx.x: Well, on his hand, they let me that, you know. But after the service, I got the service, you see I had, on his hand, he spun up, pulling there, and Willie Fawcett, he could listen, on his hand, could play trombone and clanded, and trumpet, cytoformed all that. Well, he let me not play trombone. He showed me a whole lot. So he was a precision and everything. That's why, that's why, that's why, I learned so fast, you see.
